push.title: W 4-2 vs SlimeLikely | You: 9.9
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.9 against SlimeLikely. I'm gonna need a minute. Somebody hand me a tissue and a clipboard.

THE GOOD
+ 7 shots at SlimeLikely's goal. Shooting is believing, and you believed.
+ 2 key passes. That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ Man of the Match, your 33rd for us. MOTM. Put it on the fridge and the resume.
+ Tackles attempted 7, up from your usual 2. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ You and BellyTb1 were on the same page, same paragraph, same sentence.

THE BAD
- 2 of 7 shots on target. Repeat after me: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot. Water the plant.
- 64% passing (16 of 25, down from your usual 77%). Let's try: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 1. Fix it like this: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged.
- You and BellyTb1 can fix shot selection as a duo: cut it back to each other.

This week's homework: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

One thought for the road, PhogsToffees: A coach's whistle is just a fancy way of saying 'I care.'

Thanks for making it look easy. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs SlimeLikely | You: 8.1
push.body:
An 8.1, BellyTb1. You did the little things, and the little things added up.

THE GOOD
+ Tackles attempted 7, up from your usual 2. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ 4 shots at SlimeLikely's goal. You were hungry in front of goal, and I love a hungry striker.
+ 1 key pass. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ You and PhogsToffees were a two-person band and the crowd loved it.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 3. Everybody gets a slice of that pie.

THE BAD
- Giveaways 11, up from your usual 5. We don't hide from that one; we fix it.
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Remember this: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 1. Real talk: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- PhogsToffees had the same shot selection gremlin. Squash it together: cut it back to each other.

Work on: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

Hey, BellyTb1. The other team puts their shorts on one leg at a time too.

Let the lesson stick, let the frustration go. - Coach Lasso

Alright, buddskees. EA marked this one a rage quit, and I'm not gonna pretend I didn't see it.

THE GOOD
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 3. Enjoy it. Then go get the next one.
+ Their humans averaged 6.9 to our 9.0; we out-played them man for man. Put that in the team scrapbook.
+ 4-2 win. Enjoy it, then get ready for the next one.

THE BAD
- Circle one. Just one. Then come tell me how it went.

THE UGLY
! Rage quit: you left before your stats even counted, before the final whistle, and the team played a player short. That's your 12th walk-off for us. I get it, the night was going sideways. But when one of us leaves, everybody left behind pays for it. Next time, stay, even if all you do is chase.

buddskees, take this with you: Football's like a casserole. Everybody brings something.

Shake it off and lace up. - Coach Lasso
